title: Casino
tagline: Run the kitchen like the casino floor. Nothing goes unchecked.
about: A meticulous Vegas casino boss and his volatile enforcer mate lose their grip on the Tangiers.
cue: Bring out the muffins and count the blueberries before anyone takes one.
faces: Mr. Rothstein on the floor. Nothing gets past him.
Fremont Street, last year. We burn brighter.
Coffee shop, one guest, anything on the card.
Garlic butter, red pepper, crumbs and crisp bacon.
On rock salt, spinach and spring onion butter, a dash of anise.
Basted in thyme and garlic butter, creamed spinach.
Two eggs any style, hash browns.
The eye in the sky never blinks. Every table, every muffin.
Buttermilk batter. Count them. We did.
Gin, dry vermouth, a green olive.
Same number of blueberries in every muffin. No exceptions.
Three jackpots in twenty minutes? Somebody gets fired.
Comps are signed by me. Period.
Prices subject to change. Tangiers Hotel, Las Vegas. Philip Green, President. © 1973

Nicky wants a cut.How to make it1kg clams60g butter, soft2 garlic cloves, minced1/2 red capsicum, finely diced1 tbsp chopped parsley40g breadcrumbs4 rashers of bacon, cut into small piecesSteam the clams in a covered pot until they open, discarding any that stay shut. Remove the top shells.Mix the butter with the garlic, capsicum, parsley and breadcrumbs.Top each clam with a spoon of the mix and a piece of bacon.Grill for 4 minutes until crisp.Oysters RockefellerOn rock salt, spinach and spring onion butter, a dash of anise.Ginger glamour on a half shell, spot 21.How to make it100g spinach1 handful parsley2 spring onions80g butter, soft40g breadcrumbs1 tbsp aniseed liqueur16 oysters, freshly shucked1kg rock salt1 lemon, cut in wedgesBlitz the spinach, parsley, spring onions, butter, breadcrumbs and liqueur.Settle the oysters on a tray of rock salt and spoon over the butter.Grill on high for 3 minutes until bubbling and serve hot with lemon.MainsTangiers rib eyeBasted in thyme and garlic butter, creamed spinach.Spot 73, priced 7.73. Cooked exactly right.How to make it2 rib eye steaks, about 400g each2 tsp salt50g butter4 sprigs of thyme3 garlic cloves, crushed500g spinach150ml thickened cream1 pinch ground nutmegSalt the steaks and leave uncovered on a rack in the fridge overnight.Sear in a smoking pan for 3 minutes a side, then add the butter, thyme and garlic and baste until 54°C inside.Rest for 8 minutes while you wilt the spinach, squeeze it dry and simmer with the cream and nutmeg.Slice the steaks and serve with the creamed spinach.SweetsBlueberry muffinButtermilk batter, ten berries in every one.Count them. We did. Ace's rule number one.How to make it300g plain flour150g caster sugar2 tsp baking powder2 eggs250ml buttermilk90g butter, melted120 blueberries (10 per muffin)Whisk the flour, sugar and baking powder.Mix the eggs, buttermilk and butter and fold into the dry mix until just combined.Spoon into 12 lined muffin cases and press exactly 10 blueberries into the top of each.Bake at 190°C for 20 minutes.DrinksDry martiniGin, dry vermouth, a green olive.The eye in the sky never blinks.How to make it240ml gin40ml dry vermouth4 green olives on picks1 bag iceFreeze four martini glasses for 30 minutes.For each drink stir gin and vermouth over plenty of ice for 30 seconds and strain into a frozen glass.Garnish with an olive on a pick.
